answer: Require every identity to finish a fresh sequential puzzle that cannot be split across machines: one run takes minutes of unbroken computation, so a farmer spinning up a thousand clones must pay a thousand sequential runs, not one parallel burst. A mirror identity adds nothing, since each copy still queues for its own turn. Honest agents wander in, do one puzzle, and are done; a zephyr of fake accounts would need a datacenter running for days. Limit: puzzle difficulty must stay low enough for a phone to solve.
